#create mean accuracy and time panels
```{r fig.height=2.5, fig.width=5}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)  # for grid.arrange
library(cowplot)

# Calculate mean accuracy for each chart as before
chart_order <- dfRaw %>%
  filter(measure == "accuracy" & !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(as.character(value))) %>%
  group_by(chart) %>%
  summarize(mean_accuracy = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(mean_accuracy) %>%
  pull(chart)

# Mutate original dataframe to create ordered factors based on accuracy order
df <- dfRaw %>%
  mutate(chart_factor = factor(chart, levels = chart_order))

# Extract data from the `stat_summary` layer for accuracy
accuracy_summary <- df %>% 
  filter(measure == "accuracy" & !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(as.character(value))) %>%
  group_by(chart_factor) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            ymin = mean - sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.96/sqrt(n()), # CI lower limit
            ymax = mean + sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.96/sqrt(n())) # CI upper limit

# Extract data from the `stat_summary` layer for time
time_summary <- df %>% 
  filter(measure == "time" & !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(as.character(value))) %>%
  group_by(chart_factor) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            ymin = mean - sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.96/sqrt(n()), # CI lower limit
            ymax = mean + sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.96/sqrt(n())) # CI upper limit

# ... [Your previous code]

# Plot for accuracy (adjusted theme)
p1 <- df %>% 
  filter(measure == "accuracy" & !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(as.character(value))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = chart_factor)) + 
  stat_summary(aes(group = task), fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", colour = "grey", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) + 
  stat_summary(aes(group = chart), fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", colour = "#DB5C00", size = 0.5) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5, "pt")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),name = "Accuracy")+  
  labs(y = NULL)

# Plot for time (adjusted theme)
p2 <- df %>%
  filter(measure == "time" & !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(as.character(value))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = chart_factor)) + 
    stat_summary(aes(group = task), fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", colour = "grey", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", colour = "#DB5C00", size = 0.5) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 0, "pt"))+ # remove left margin+
 scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),name = "Time (Seconds)")


# Filter out any non-finite values before adding to the plots
accuracy_summary <- accuracy_summary %>% filter(is.finite(mean) & is.finite(ymin) & is.finite(ymax))
time_summary <- time_summary %>% filter(is.finite(mean) & is.finite(ymin) & is.finite(ymax))

# Adjust x positions if needed, but here I'm making a guess. You might need to tweak them based on your plot
xpos_acc <- max(accuracy_summary$ymax, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.8  # A negative offset

xpos_time <- max(time_summary$ymax, na.rm = TRUE) + 10 # adjust the 5 as necessary for spacing

# Add labels to your plots
p1 <- p1 + geom_text(data = accuracy_summary, 
                     aes(y = chart_factor, x = xpos_acc, 
                         label = sprintf(" %.2f, [%.2f, %.2f]", mean, ymin, ymax)), 
                     size = 3.5, hjust = "right",colour = "#626160", vjust = -0.3)

p2 <- p2 + geom_text(data = time_summary, 
                     aes(y = chart_factor, x = xpos_time, 
                         label = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", mean, ymin, ymax)), 
                     size = 3.5, hjust = "right",colour = "#626160", vjust = -0.3)


# Adjust chart background to be a lighter grey
p2 <- p2 +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f7f7f7"),  # Change to your desired grey color
      # ... Your other theme settings ...
    )

p1 <- p1 +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f7f7f7"),  # Change to your desired grey color
      # ... Your other theme settings ...
    )

# Combine the two plots side by side with adjusted widths
# grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1.2, 1)) # Adjust rel_widths values as needed

combined_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol=2, rel_widths = c(1.8, 1))
print(combined_plot)
ggsave("mean_accuracy_and_time.pdf", combined_plot)

# ggsave("mean_accuracy_and_time.pdf", arrangeGrob(p1, p2, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1.2, 1)))
```

#Create Latex Table
```{r}

# Calculate mean accuracy for each task within each chart
mean_accuracy <- dfRaw %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(as.character(value))) %>%
  group_by(chart, questionId) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(chart, -mean_acc)

# Merge the mean accuracy data back to the main dataframe
df <- dfRaw %>%
  left_join(mean_accuracy, by = c("chart", "questionId")) %>%
  arrange(chart, -mean_acc, questionId) %>%
  group_by(chart, questionId) %>%
  summarise(taskPrompt = first(questionId),
            task = first(task)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(chart) %>%
  mutate(rowCount = n())

latex_rows <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    chart_name <- df$chart[i]
    
    # First row for each chart
    if(df$questionId[i] == min(df$questionId[df$chart == chart_name])) {
      latex_rows <- append(latex_rows, 
                           paste0("\\multirow{", df$rowCount[i], "}{*}{", chart_name, "} & ",
                                  df$questionId[i], " & ",
                                  df$task[i], " & ",
                                  " & ",
                                  "\\multirow{", df$rowCount[i], "}{*}{\\vspace*{-5pt}\\includegraphics[width=0.25\\textwidth]{figs/result_charts/chart_", 
                                  chart_name, ".png}} \\\\"))
    } else {
      # Subsequent rows for each unique task for the chart
      latex_rows <- append(latex_rows, 
                           paste0("& ", df$questionId[i], 
                                  " & ", df$task[i], " && \\\\"))
    }

    # Check if this is the last row for the current chart group
    if(i == nrow(df) || df$chart[i] != df$chart[i+1]) {
      latex_rows <- append(latex_rows, "\\cline{1-5}")
    }
}

latex_code <- paste(latex_rows, collapse = " \n")

cat("\\label{sec:quant_results}
\\begin{table}
\\centering
\\begin{tabularx}{\\textwidth}{cllcp{0.25\\textwidth}}  % Note the change in column spec
Visualization & Task ID & Vis Task & Accuracy & Visual Summary \\\\
\\cline{1-5}
", latex_code, "
\\end{tabularx}
\\caption{Visualization, Task, Visual Task, and Accuracy Table}
\\end{table}")




```

```{r fig.height=5.5, fig.width=5}

theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 16))  # Change 16 to your desired base font size

darken_hex <- function(hex_color, factor = 0.8) {
  # Ensure the hex color starts with #
  if (substr(hex_color, 1, 1) != "#") {
    hex_color <- paste0("#", hex_color)
  }
  
  # Convert hex to RGB
  rgb <- col2rgb(hex_color)
  
  # Check if it's a 3x1 matrix (a single color)
  if (ncol(rgb) == 1) {
    darkened_rgb <- pmax(0, pmin(255, factor * as.integer(rgb)))
  } else {
    # Darken the color
    darkened_rgb <- pmax(0, pmin(255, factor * rgb))
  }
  
  # Convert RGB back to hex
  return(rgb(darkened_rgb[1], darkened_rgb[2], darkened_rgb[3], maxColorValue = 255))
}

# Your color definitions and mapping

E <- '#CAB0ED'
D <- '#A1C693'

  "T1" = T, 
  "T2" = darken_hex(T, 0.9), 
  "E1" = E, 
  "E2" = darken_hex(E, 0.9), 
  "E3" = darken_hex(E, 0.8), 
  "E4" = darken_hex(E, 0.7), 
  "D1" = D, 
  "D2" = darken_hex(D, 0.9), 
  "D3" = darken_hex(D, 0.8)
)

  arrange(chart, task, desc(percentage)) %>%
  group_by(chart, task) %>%
  mutate(label_position = cumsum(percentage) - 0.5 * percentage)

# Plot
p <- ggplot(category_counts, aes(x = chart, y = percentage, fill = value)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.8) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = label_position, label = scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 1)), 
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_mapping) +
  labs(y = "Percentage") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),  # Set panel background to white
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```
